method.change: Learn domestic shade/vintage/tare scaling jointly with soft regional hierarchy and contextual convergence; foreign scores unchanged. Tare curves scaled by positive factor, preserving exact pure-tare ties and score direction; classifier margins can change.
method.prior: Same centered [2,1,1,0,0] tier template, context gains, 20-year shrinkage and weak 20-vs30 premium-region dominance scenarios as regional-only model; add a soft average hierarchy-order penalty. Exact prior margin conventions are not elicited prices.
method.validation: Same outer family partitions and base offering settings; inner grouped training refits both offering and weighted hierarchy to select prior strength. Expanded prior explored after regional-only result, so this is exploratory repeated validation, not a pristine new test.
